facts.fact: Intelwatch reports that Angola's electoral roll is derived from the civil identity database, under which the Bilhete de Identidade is the identity credential, and that the 2025 law makes the Bilhete de Identidade the sole registration credential from 2027.
Intelwatch reports a EUR 130 million contract with Hungary's ANY Security Printing for biometric passports and identity documents, part of contracts exceeding US$250 million.
facts.system: biometric identity document programme (ANY Security Printing contract)

systems.system: National biometric control system (Dolinveste Lda / Technology for Business)
